update_description: Checks the JGates repository for a newer version and, after you confirm, installs it the same way as this one. Uses the network only when you run it.
update_option_ref: Branch or tag to compare with (default main).
update_not_found: Could not find the JGates package folder of this installation.
update_no_repository: The package.json of this installation names no repository to compare with.
update_git_missing: Git is not installed: it is needed to ask the repository for its newest version.
update_git_missing_fix: Install Git (jgates doctor shows how) and run again.
update_ref_not_found: The repository has no branch or tag named {ref}.
update_ref_not_found_fix: Use --ref with an existing branch or tag, or leave it out for main.
update_remote_failed_fix: Check the internet connection and try again.
update_text_asking: Asking {repository} for the newest commit of {ref}...
update_state_unknown: This build does not say which commit it came from, so it cannot be compared; installing the newest one is safe.
update_manual_clone: This JGates runs from a clone ({packageDir}). To update it: git pull, then npm install and npm run build in that folder.
update_manual_global: A global npm install cannot be updated from the repository directly. Clone {repository}, run npm install and npm pack in it, then npm install --global ./jgates-<version>.tgz.
update_text_use_yes: Nothing was installed: run again with --yes to install.
update_install_failed_fix: Read the npm output above; the previous version stays installed.
update_text_after: Open terminals keep working. If you use the quality sidecar image, rebuild it from a clone: docker build -t jgates/quality-sidecar:latest <clone>/quality-gate
update_ui_running: An update is already being installed.
update_ui_not_checked: This version was not found by the last check.
update_ui_not_checked_fix: Check for updates again, then install.
update_ui_manual: This installation cannot be updated from the interface: follow the steps shown.
